title: Horns Set Two Bigs
description: A classic horns alignment with two post players at the elbows, practising the ball-screen and pass options it creates.

content.objective: Run the horns alignment cleanly, reading which elbow player screens and which pops.
content.setup: A ball handler starts at the top with two post players at both elbows and a shooter in the corner.
instructions: The ball handler passes to one elbow player.
The other elbow player sets a ball screen or cuts to the rim, based on the coach's call.
The ball handler reads the defense off the screen and attacks or passes.
Reset with the two elbow players swapping which one screens.
coachingPoints: Keep the spacing wide so the elbows don't collapse into each other.
Screeners should be stationary and legal before contact.
Ball handler should attack downhill, not sideways, off the screen.
commonMistakes: Both elbow players cutting to the same side and crowding the lane.
Ball handler drifting away from the screen instead of using it.
Crowding a teammate's space instead of keeping good spacing.
content.safety: Screens must be set legally; no moving into a defender.
